name: Template D: Standing Hearing Committee (SHC) Compliance Pathway
aphSourceReference: Approval Process Handbook 2024–2027 Chapter II, Clauses 2.19, 2.20 & 2.21
description: Quasi-judicial compliance and determination workflow for applications with persistent unresolved deficiencies after re-scrutiny or adverse EVC reports. Adjudicated before the Standing Hearing Committee (SHC).
statutoryConstraints: Minimum 5 working days advance written summons notice to institution
SHC bench must include a retired High Court Judge or senior academician of national eminence
SHC may order a surprise physical inspection (EVC) if factual physical data is disputed
SHC issues recommendations only; final statutory speaking order is reserved for Council
